title: A style added by link loses its front place when an unrelated style-list update arrives first
trigger: Add a custom style from a t.me/addstyle link (the add answers ok, apply_ai_compose_ok calls promote_name for a name the list does not hold yet), then an updateTextCompositionStyles that does not list it yet arrives (set_server -> reapply_recent).
effect: reapply_recent rebuilds `recent` only from styles the new list holds, so the name is dropped; when a later list does include the style it sits in server order instead of at the front of the Style tabs. Cosmetic order only; the style itself is kept.
fix: Keep a remembered name in `recent` until a list that holds it has been applied, or until forget(); only prune names the server has listed and then removed.

title: EditRender::Rendering(u64) names a render whose task is detached and matched by a counter
trigger: Edit a photo message, open the photo editor, press Done, then cancel the edit (or start another) before the render lands
effect: The PNG render and encode still run to the end (wasted work) and the result is deleted when it lands; nothing wrong on screen. The stage holds a NEXT_RENDER number instead of the Task, so leaving the stage cannot cancel it.
fix: Rendering { _job: Task<()> } held in the stage (as the tray item's render should be), so dropping the edit cancels it; drop the NEXT_RENDER counter match in photo_editor_save.rs

title: PhotoPrep::Rendering { render: u64 } names a photo-edit render whose task is detached and matched by a counter
trigger: Press Done in the photo editor on a tray photo, then remove the photo (or send) before the render lands
effect: No wrong result today: land_attachment_edit matches the render number against the stage and drops a stale file. The stage holds a NEXT_RENDER number, not the Task, so leaving the stage cannot cancel the render, and the stage plus `before: Box<PhotoPrep>` is a nested copy of the settled stage kept in step by set_photo/abandon_render/land_render.
fix: Rendering { job: Task<()>, before } with the Task held in the stage; PhotoPrep::settled stays the one reader

title: owner-file write is retried on every ingest while the account folder cannot be written
trigger: Account folder becomes read-only or the disk is full after sign-in, then updates keep arriving
effect: One failed file write (and filesystem work) per ingested update on the driver thread; logged once only
fix: OwnerClaim::Unsaved carries a retry deadline (a manual-clock Instant) so the write is retried on a timer, not per update

title: Share Folder `links` list is begun but never records its RequestId (`chats` does)
trigger: Open Share Folder, retry or delete a link while the first getChatFolderInviteLinks is out
effect: A late older answer for the folder is applied by purpose and folder id, not by the request the stage waits for, so it can overwrite the list after a delete
fix: call links.sent(extra) and match ChatFolderInviteLinks answers by the stage's RequestId like `chats`

title: Fetches begun without recording their RequestId (welcome pack, installed sticker/emoji lists for the group sticker picker)
trigger: Open the welcome-messages box or the group sticker picker, then refetch (mutation refetch, reopen) while an older load is still out
effect: The stage says Loading but holds no request, so an older answer is matched by purpose and chat, not by the request the stage waits for, and can land over a newer load
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin() as emoji_set_request and the Share Folder `chats` list do

title: Style lookup and style example stages are `Running` with no RequestId; answers are matched by a UI token
trigger: Open an addstyle link or a style example, then the request is lost (reconnect, stale sweep) before an answer
effect: `StyleReply::Running` is only left by an answer or error that carries the same token; a request dropped without either leaves the lookup spinning until a new token replaces it
fix: StyleReply::Running { request: RequestId } so the answer is matched by the stage's request and a lost request fails it

title: More fetches are begun without recording their RequestId (Star packs list, sign-in app config)
trigger: Open Buy more Stars or the QR sign-in screen; the request is lost or an older answer arrives after a refetch
effect: The stage reads Loading but holds no request, so the answer is matched by purpose, and a request dropped without an answer is not noticed by the stage
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin() so the Fetch stage holds its request, as `Fetch::sent` is designed for

title: Wearable gifts list is begun without recording its RequestId
trigger: Open the name color box, close and reopen it while the first getWearableGifts is still out
effect: The list reads Loading but holds no request, so the older answer is matched by purpose and can land over the newer load; a lost request leaves it Loading
fix: call .sent(extra) after begin(), like background_emoji_icons in the same file

title: A refused public-forwards send leaves the forwards list Idle with no failure or Retry
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the sender refuses the second send (getMessagePublicForwards); fetch_message_public_forwards returns the error via `?` before forwards_requested, and the caller discards it with `let _ =`
effect: The statistics load but the public-forwards section never fills and offers no Retry; only reopening the page asks again
fix: Mark forwards Failed (as send_failed does for wallet lists) when the send is refused

title: send_web_app_custom_request leaves its custom_requests entry when the send is refused
trigger: A mini app invokes a custom method while the client refuses the send (closing client); the entry keyed by the reserved request id is inserted before send_json_request and never removed on Err
effect: A dead (launch_id, req_id) entry stays in web_apps.custom_requests for the life of the session; the app never gets an error for that req_id
fix: Insert after the send succeeds, or remove the entry in the Err arm; better, hold the req_id in the pending request itself

title: A release that times out aborts the whole account export (chat path tolerates it, section path does not)
trigger: Account export with Profile pictures, Stories or Music on; after a section file is copied, release_if_untouched sends getFile/deleteFile and TDLib does not answer within QUERY_TIMEOUT (300 s); ChannelTdlib::call returns Err(ExportError::Tdlib("the request timed out")) and Files::save propagates it with `source.release(tdlib)?`
effect: run_inner returns the error, the export ends as Failed after possibly hours of work, though the file was already copied; the chat path (worker.rs save_once) explicitly ignores ExportError::Tdlib from release, so the same stall costs nothing there. The copied file is also never recorded in LoadedFiles
fix: Match the chat path: treat Err(ExportError::Tdlib(_)) from release as a leftover (Ok) and keep going; only Cancelled and Io end the export

title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a two-variant flag kept beside the export's real stage
trigger: Hide the account-export progress box, switch accounts or let the export end
effect: Whether a finished export shows a note or is cleared depends on `view` (poll_account_export_progress reads export.view == Hidden) held in AccountExport/ChatExport next to the progress Mutex and the WorkerLink; the box's open state and the export's stage are three separately written things. No bug traced today: set_account_export_view is the only writer and the poll clears a settled hidden export
fix: Fold the view into the progress stage owner (for example Running{shown} / Settled) or into the dialog stage so one value says whether the box is on screen

title: GiftFlow::sends matches a collection form's answer by PaymentsPurpose, so another ChangeGiftCollection request takes over the form's Sent(request)
trigger: With the New/Rename collection form open (Editing), a ChangeGiftCollection mutation from the gifts list (mutate_own_gifts -> flow_sent(purpose, extra)) is sent
effect: The form is marked Sent(other request) and closes on that unrelated answer, or stays 'sending' for a request it never made
fix: Pass the form's own RequestId into flow_sent from the form's submit path instead of matching by purpose

title: GiftMarketState::balance_low is a one-shot bool latch beside the notes/toasts queues
trigger: A paid gift request (buy, bid) is refused for too few Stars
effect: Today the UI drains it with mem::take and opens Stars; no bug, but the same event class (one-shot toast) lives in a Vec of strings and a bool, drained together by hand
fix: One Vec<MarketEvent> (Note(String), Toast{..}, BalanceLow) drained once

title: BadgeStage::Failed is pushed again on every sync_icon_badge pass with no backoff
trigger: Linux with no session bus or no listening dock, or Windows before the taskbar button exists, with the chrome loop running
effect: Each pass wakes the launcher worker, which retries Connection::session() and answers Failed again; wasted work for as long as the bus is missing
fix: Failed carries a retry-after deadline (or retries only on a wake poke from a tray/dock event)

title: Picker stages named by a request (VenueBot::Resolving, AskStage::InFlight, TileState::Requested) are never reconciled with the pending-request registry while the picker is open
trigger: Open Send Location, then a TDLib reconnect or client restart drops the venue-bot lookup, venue query or tile request without an error update
effect: Venue list stays Loading, or the map tile stays blank (Requested is never retried; move_ended only clears Failed) until the picker is closed and reopened
fix: A forget_dropped(pending) sweep like MessageEffects::forget_dropped, run after each ingest in pump_location_picker

title: MediaViewer 'open' is items.is_empty() and total only means something for SharedMedia/Profile sources
trigger: Open the viewer from the chat, from Shared Media, from a profile gallery
effect: Works today: open_* set source and total together; position() and wants_older() must re-check source by hand
fix: enum MediaViewerSource carrying total (Chat, Shared{total}, Profile{owner,total}, Poll) and an explicit Closed

title: NewChatStage::Creating keeps a RequestId and a CreateProgress that is re-derived from the request registry on each poll
trigger: Create a group and watch it settle (settled_new_chat)
effect: Created/Refused/Lost are stored inside Creating although nothing is in flight; request stays as a stale key and progress is a cached copy of Session.requests/creations
fix: Lift Refused/Lost/Created to their own NewChatStage variants and drop request once answered

title: The QR box keeps three hand-rolled request counters (box_id+serial, FreeTicket serial, GiftsAsk serial) beside RequestId
trigger: Open the QR box, save a theme, request a free code and open the gifts panel
effect: No bug today: each answer is matched to the serial held in its stage. But each stage (ThemeStage::Saving { serial }, FreeUi::Requesting { serial }, GiftsStage::FirstAsking(GiftsAsk)) holds a counter value instead of the RequestId of its request, so a request the table drops is not tied to the stage that waits for it, and PeerQrData::saves and free_answers/save_answers are queues that nothing drains while no box is open.
fix: Hold the RequestId in each stage (Saving { request }, Requesting { request }, FirstAsking { request }) and settle the stage from the request table, so the box going away drops its answers with it

title: A getProxies that could not be sent has no retry for a background account, and FailedStale keeps the list busy
trigger: The first or a refetch getProxies fails to send (ConnectSendError::Native/InvalidRequest, e.g. the client is closing) for a background account or an account whose proxy box is never opened
effect: fetch_unsent() sets Failed or FailedStale. wanted() is false for both, and the only caller of fetch_proxies() is ui/proxy/mod.rs:126, the on-screen dialog open. A background account's sync_proxies_to() returns false for good: Failed leaves the list None, FailedStale keeps busy() true, so its proxy list never mirrors the app's. On screen, rotation and the system-proxy step plan nothing until the user opens the proxy list.
fix: A retry owned by the stage (ProxyFetch::Failed { at } retried after a backoff on the next ingest) instead of a stage only a dialog open can leave

title: A corrupt accounts.json whose quarantine rename fails is never marked unreadable, so the next save overwrites it and re-parses it every frame
trigger: accounts.json fails to parse and std::fs::rename to accounts.json.corrupt-<ts> fails (file locked by a scanner on Windows, read-only parent); then add_account/set_active_account/rename_account runs
effect: The Some(Err) arm of load_registry returns the default registry without note_read(path,false) or caching. save_registry only refuses for paths in UNREADABLE, so the first save replaces the corrupt-but-recoverable account list with [primary]. Until then every UI frame (active_account is read per frame) re-reads, re-parses, retries the rename and prints to stderr.
fix: On the quarantine failure arm call note_read(&path,false) (or keep a Corrupt{path} stage in LOADED) so saves refuse and the read is cached until the file's stamp changes

title: Every geometry report spawns a writer thread that queues behind the write lock, there is no 'a writer is running' stage
trigger: Drag or resize the main window on a slow or scanned disk (fsync tens of ms) while stage_window_state + save_staged_window_state run per move event
effect: One OS thread per call, each blocked on Saver::write and then finding the slot empty; a long drag piles up hundreds of parked threads and, if the spawn fails, the call is silently dropped (only the quit flush saves it)
fix: A Writer stage (Idle | Running) in Saver, as DeferredWriter has, so a call while Running only stages and the running writer re-reads the slot before it exits

title: ReviewItem::request is an Option<RequestId> used as an 'was it sent yet' flag, matched by is_none() plus the session id
trigger: Review the new-login alert: begin_login_review creates one ReviewItem per session with request None, then login_review_sent / login_review_unsent find the first item with request.is_none() and the same entry id
effect: No bug today (review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses empty entry lists and settles every item on send failure). The two stages of an item, 'to send' and 'in flight under this request', are one Option, so an item that is neither sent nor reported unsent (a new send path that returns early) keeps the review Reviewing with no way out
fix: enum ReviewItemStage { ToSend, InFlight(RequestId) } inside ReviewItem, so Reviewing cannot hold an item that has no stage transition left

title: ChatSummary::my_member and ::my_restriction are two own-membership fields that must change together, but set_member_status moves only the first
trigger: Viewer is Restricted in a supergroup (my_restriction = Restricted(until 0)); an admin lifts the restriction and TDLib's updateSupergroup says Member before (or without) the own updateChatMember; or the viewer leaves (optimistic set_member_status(Left)) and rejoins
effect: adopt_supergroup_status / set_member_status(Member|Left) rewrites my_member only, so ChatSummary::restriction() still returns the old Restricted record: SendRights::personal() keeps blocking the composer and attachments with 'The admins ... restricted you' until an updateChatMember arrives (session_members.rs:200 is the only place that resets both)
fix: One OwnMembership enum (Unknown | Other(status) | Restricted{restriction} | Administrator(rights)) so a status change replaces the restriction with it, as AdminRights already does

title: HangUp::engine_hang_up_due is a one-shot bool for the second stage of a hang-up, set by the reducer and taken by the driver
trigger: discardCall answers ok (apply_hang_up_ok sets the flag); the driver pump (connect/calls/mod.rs:459) takes it with mem::take on its next pass
effect: No bug today: the terminal updateCall path hangs the engine up through active_call_before, so a dropped flag is covered. But the stage 'TDLib took the hang-up' lives as a bool beside `request`, and a pump that does not run (driver gone, account off screen) leaves the engine call open with the flag set
fix: HangUp as an enum { Requested(RequestId), Accepted } (or an EngineHangUp::{Owed, Done} the pump settles), so the flag is a stage that has a way out

title: ChatsState::background_error is documented one-shot but only a wallpaper preview opening clears it, so a failure line stays on the Appearance page
trigger: Offline, delete an installed Telegram wallpaper (RemoveInstalledBackground / DeleteDefaultBackground fails; error.rs:68 sets background_error), go back online and delete it again (ok), or just close and reopen Settings > Appearance
effect: appearance_telegram_wallpapers_section draws 'Couldn't update wallpapers: ...' from a clone of the field on every frame (telegram_wallpapers.rs:41,155). apply_backgrounds_ok never clears it, retry_failed_wallpapers clears only the Fetch errors of installed_backgrounds, leave_wallpaper_gallery clears only the remove confirm. Only open_wallpaper_preview_at / open_background_link (wallpaper_preview.rs:103,118) set it to None, so the stale line outlives the success and the page
fix: Hold the failure beside the request it belongs to (Answers / a Failed stage with its RequestId), or clear it in apply_backgrounds_ok and in retry_failed_wallpapers/leave_wallpaper_gallery

title: Deep-link join/check answers are matched by a generation counter in the purpose, not the RequestId held in DeepLinkState::ResolvingChat
trigger: Open two invite deep links in a row
effect: Matching works while the counter is bumped for every start; any start path that forgets the bump lets an old answer apply
fix: ResolvingChat { request: RequestId } compared with pending.id

title: ToggleBroadcastGroup error rolls back by removing the supergroup_is_broadcast entry instead of restoring the prior value
trigger: Toggle to a broadcast group on a supergroup whose flag was already known, request refused
effect: The known flag is lost until the next updateSupergroup
fix: Use PendingRequest::rollback like the other optimistic toggles

title: waits_for / answer_administrators / fail_administrators treat a missing entry as waiting, so any request's answer lands
trigger: UpdateChatMember removes admin_lists and forgets the request by purpose; a second GetChatAdministrators sent earlier by another window answers into the empty slot
effect: An answer asked before the membership change fills the list with old administrators
fix: Insert Loading(request) when sending and accept only Loading(own id)

title: Join requests live in two parallel states (GroupsState::join_requests chat-wide and InvitePages::join_requests per link), both edited by forget_join_request and filled by purpose-routed answers
trigger: Approve a request while the chat-wide list and a link's list are both loaded
effect: No bug traced; each writer must update both lists and both totals by hand
fix: One JoinRequests value keyed by (chat, scope) with one forget method

title: members_added leaves SupergroupMembersFetch::Loading{request:None} (nothing in flight) and relies on the one-shot member_list_stale drained by the main window poll
trigger: A member is added/changed while the member panel is not open in the main window (chat window, or panel closed); the poll drains member_list_stale with take()
effect: The cached page stays Loading with no request; a reopened panel shows a spinner until something else asks
fix: A Stale variant of Fetch (data kept, refetch owed) read by whoever opens the panel, instead of a drained one-shot list

title: members_added leaves SupergroupMembersFetch::Loading{request:None} (waiting for a refetch nobody sent) and relies on the one-shot member_list_stale drained by the main window poll
trigger: A member is added/changed while the member panel is not open in the main window (chat window, or panel closed); the poll drains member_list_stale with take()
effect: A panel that is not open in the main window when the mark is drained keeps drawing a spinner for a Loading that has no request until a reader notices in_flight() is false and asks
fix: A Stale variant of Fetch (data kept, refetch owed) read by whoever opens the panel, instead of a drained one-shot list

title: is_latest_member_request accepts any answer when MemberAsk.first is None (after a refused first page)
trigger: Type a member search that is refused at send (note_member_refused sets first: None, query: new) while an older first-page request is still in flight; the older answer arrives
effect: The list for the new query shows the older query's results (Failed is overwritten by Loaded of another query)
fix: Keep the request in one stage enum per list (Fetch with RequestId); a refused send is Failed with a fresh stage id that no older answer can match

title: One member list stage is held in three places: supergroup_members Fetch, member_asks.first and member_asks.more
trigger: Any member search or scroll
effect: No bug traced beyond 08-001; the three must be kept in step by note_member_first/refused/more and every error arm
fix: One MemberList enum per (chat, filter) holding query, first-page request and next-page request

title: AI compose box, apply-in-place, lookup and example answers are matched by a u64 token in the purpose, not the RequestId; StyleReply::Running holds nothing
trigger: Open and close the AI box repeatedly
effect: Works while every start mints a new token; the in-flight stage (StyleReply::Running, StyleLookup, ExampleAnswer) holds no request or task and nothing cancels it when the box closes
fix: Stage variants holding RequestId; the answer slot keyed by RequestId

title: style_edit is one slot for every Create/Save answer; a second answer in the same drain overwrites the first editor's answer
trigger: Two style editors (two windows, or Create then Save) have requests in flight; both answer before the UI drain
effect: The overwritten editor never receives its answer and stays in its saving stage
fix: A queue of StyleEditAnswer keyed by RequestId (like ai_answers), taken by the editor that holds that request

title: style_notice is one Option slot: a second notice overwrites the first before the UI shows it; style_op_failures grows if nothing drains it
trigger: Add and Remove of two styles fail in the same frame
effect: One toast lost; the preview waiting on the lost one is released only through style_op_failures
fix: Notes-style bounded queue

title: GetSharingProtection answer and error write PrivateSharingState::enable with no stage waiting for it
trigger: Tap Enable Sharing, close or leave the chat before the answer, or tap twice
effect: A late answer or error opens the Send Request? box (or starts turning protection off) for a chat the user already left; nothing records that an ask is out
fix: enum EnableSharing { Idle, Asking{chat,request}, TurnOff, AskToRequest } matched on pending.id and reset by the box close

title: One-shot answer slots with no owner or request (message_link, instant_view, unread_jump) take whatever answered last
trigger: Share link on message A then B quickly; or lock the app while an answer lands
effect: The copy toast or reader belongs to the wrong message, or fires after unlock
fix: Slots keyed by RequestId, taken by the window that holds that request

title: draft_clears / failed_sends are unbounded Vec queues drained only by the composer UI
trigger: Many sends while the window is hidden or locked
effect: Queues grow and a later composer clears the server draft of an unrelated earlier send
fix: Per-slot DraftClear stage owned by the composer slot

title: MessagesState::sponsored_hidden is a session-long bool set from three places (ok of toggleHasSponsoredMessagesEnabled, report result AdsHidden, UI) and never cleared
trigger: hide ads as Premium, later lose Premium or turn ads back on elsewhere, or log out and in within one Session
effect: ads stay hidden and unfetched for the Session's life regardless of the account's setting
fix: derive from the account's has_sponsored_messages_enabled option instead of a local latch

title: Several payment errors write shared state without matching the request: GetGiftTextLimit clears gift_text_length_max, ToggleGiftSaved/SellGift abandon the open gift confirmation, GetStarPackOptions drops data, GetPaymentReceipt-like unmatched succeed on star_packs.options and wearable_gifts
trigger: An older request fails or answers while a newer one (or another gift's confirmation) is on screen
effect: The newer value is cleared or the confirmation of another gift closes
fix: Settle with Fetch::answered/failed(Some(pending.id), ..)

title: A sendPaymentForm in flight is a Vec entry beside CheckoutForm::Ready; it leaves only on the answer or error
trigger: Press Pay, the request is lost (connection reset, dropped continuation) so neither apply_payload nor apply_error runs for it
effect: is_paying stays true for the invoice: Pay shows Processing... and stays disabled until the app restarts; the same row also blocks a retry of the same invoice
fix: CheckoutForm::Paying { request, checkout } (or PaymentInFlight swept by the request table when its request is lost)

title: optimizeStorage answer sets storage_clear = Freed and drops storage_stats by purpose, without StorageClear::Clearing holding a request
trigger: Clear cache, then reopen the screen (reset_storage_freed) and clear again while the first answer is late
effect: The first answer shows Freed for the second clear and the statistics refetch races it
fix: StorageClear::Clearing { request: RequestId } (baseline: bare:StorageClear::Clearing)

title: ConfirmDeviceLogin answer and error write DeviceLogin::Done without checking a link is waiting for that request
trigger: Confirm a device link, leave the Sessions page (DeviceLogin::discard), then the answer arrives
effect: Done { request } sits unclaimed (no taker) and a later link confirmation page sees a result for a request it never sent only when ids collide; sessions_op/sessions error is still written
fix: DeviceLogin::Waiting { request } set at send, Done only from Waiting with the same id

title: LanguageStage::Fetching holds a generation counter and a base: bool in the purpose, not the RequestIds of its two getLanguagePackStrings requests
trigger: Switch language twice quickly
effect: Works while every switch bumps generation; the stage cannot tell which of its two asks is still out, and a lost ask is handled only through the generic lost-request error
fix: Fetching { pack: Fetch<Strings>, base: Fetch<Strings> } each holding its RequestId

title: Sticker lists, search results, trending, favorites, recents and mask lists are applied by request purpose (accept_*), with the stale answer dropped only by take_purpose before the next send
trigger: Two searchStickers or installed-set fetches in flight (two windows, or a send path that forgets take_purpose)
effect: An older answer overwrites the newer list; the list Fetch is settled by id but the data is written regardless of that result
fix: Write the data only when Fetch::answered(Some(pending.id), ..) returns true

title: ActiveStoriesPaging::Idle means both "nothing asked" and "a page is in flight"; the in-flight page lives only in the request table and is found by has_purpose(LoadActiveStories)
trigger: Any story list page
effect: No bug traced (connect/stories/mod.rs checks has_purpose before sending), but the stage is split between this enum and the request table, matched by purpose not RequestId
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } variant

title: bot_thread_starts and topic_action_answers are 8-entry queues taken by request id; the oldest answer is dropped when more arrive
trigger: A window that asked is hidden or locked while more than 8 topic actions or bot-thread starts from other windows answer
effect: The waiting window never gets its answer: the composer or topic menu stays in its in-flight stage
fix: Answer stored in the asking window's stage (WindowSlot) keyed by RequestId, dropped with the window

title: TopicsLoad::Asked is a bare in-flight variant ("asked, and may have answered") and page_failed applies any failing LoadDirectMessagesChatTopics by chat id
trigger: Scroll the direct-messages tabs so two pages are in flight; an older page fails with 404 after a newer page answered
effect: The chat is marked Exhausted early, so no more conversations load until the chat is reopened
fix: Fetch-like stage holding the RequestId of the page in flight; Exhausted only from that request

title: ForumTopicsMap::failed_request fails a Ready or Idle list for any request's error (_ => true), and answered takes any answer while Loading has no request yet
trigger: An older getForumTopics fails after a newer one answered, or an answer lands between begin() and sent()
effect: A loaded forum list flips to Failed (reads failure state, not asked again) or takes an answer of the wrong request
fix: Settle only Loading { request: Some(id) } with the same id

title: SaveWatch is one Session-wide slot for the profile box's save; a profile box in another window replaces the watched request
trigger: Edit Contact open in the main window and a chat window; Save in one, then Save in the other before the first answers
effect: The first box's request is no longer watched: take_outcome returns Unknown, the box can neither close as saved nor show the refusal
fix: Watch held in the box's own stage (WindowSlot) keyed by RequestId

title: HistoryState::opened_with_unread and unread_anchor are two fields of one 'opened at the first unread' mode, cleared together by end_unread_open and separately by drop_unread_bar_for
trigger: Delete the message the Unread bar sits above, then open another window on the chat
effect: No bug traced; the pair must be changed in step by hand at each call site
fix: enum UnreadOpen { Closed, Opened { anchor: Option<MessageId> } }

title: A chat's event log stage is split between ChatEventLogFetch::Loading (bare) and EventLog::wait { page, poll } holding the RequestIds
trigger: Change the event-log filter while a page and a poll are in flight
effect: Correct while reset_event_log_fetch clears both together; any path that sets fetch without clearing wait lets a stale answer fill the new list
fix: Loading { page: RequestId, poll: Option<RequestId> } as the one stage (baseline: bare:ChatEventLogFetch::Loading)

title: MessageReactionsState is one Session-wide slot for the message menu's reaction strip, and Loading holds (chat, message) not a RequestId
trigger: Open the message menu on message A in the main window and on message B in a chat window (or reopen the menu on A twice) while getMessageAvailableReactions is out
effect: The second menu replaces the first's Loading/Ready; the first window's strip flips to Unavailable or shows another message's options, and a late answer for the same message from the older request is accepted
fix: Per-window (WindowSlot) reaction options holding Loading { request: RequestId }

title: ChatPinOrder and ArchiveChatListSettings rollbacks restore the old value without checking that the shown value is still the one this request set
trigger: Reorder pinned chats, an updateChatPosition for another reorder lands, then the first setPinnedChats is refused
effect: The refusal overwrites the newer order from the server with the pre-reorder order until the next position update
fix: Carry shown like the other rollbacks and restore only while it still holds

title: PendingRequest carries about twenty Option correlation fields (chat_id, user_id, supergroup_id, community_id, story_id, folder_id, scope, subject_id, ...) beside purpose, each set by hand for the purposes that need it, and handlers drop the answer when the field they need is None
trigger: Add or change a sender that forgets to stamp a field its handler reads
effect: The answer is silently ignored (if let Some(chat_id) = pending.chat_id) and the stage that waited for it never leaves; the in-flight state is also a purpose scan over the table (has_purpose_for_*)
fix: Purpose variants carry their own key (as GroupsPurpose::GetAdminRights { user_id } does) and stages hold the RequestId

title: SavedTopicsLoad::Started is a bare in-flight stage; answers settle by RequestPurpose::LoadSavedMessagesTopics, not a RequestId
trigger: open Saved Messages while a sublist page is in flight, then a second window/pump asks again
effect: dedupe and the 404/error arm settle by purpose, so another request with that purpose ends the stage
fix: SavedTopicsLoad::Loading { request: RequestId } settled in connect/forum_saved.rs and threads/error.rs by id

title: SearchPaging::Loading is a bare in-flight stage next to SearchState::generation; a page answer is matched by search generation, not a RequestId
trigger: scroll the global search list, change filter, scroll again
effect: the next-page ask holds no request, so an answer is trusted through the generation counter only

title: Leg::Pending is a bare in-flight stage for three search legs, matched by search_generation; only Paying carries a RequestId
trigger: type a query, retype while legs are out
effect: answers matched by a counter in PendingRequest instead of the request held in the stage
fix: Leg::Pending { request: RequestId }

title: fourteen parallel per-supergroup maps (restrict/invite/promote/manage_tags/manage_topics/change_info/send_welcome rights, join_by_request, is_broadcast, sign_messages, show_message_sender, anti_spam, can_toggle_anti_spam) written together in two copies of the same block and never removed together
trigger: updateSupergroup applies; the chat is deleted or the user leaves
effect: rights of a gone supergroup stay in every map; the two near-identical write blocks (apply_update_supergroup, apply_supergroup) can drift
fix: one SupergroupFacts struct per supergroup id, replaced whole

title: Audience<T>::Loading and ::Paging are bare in-flight stages for five lists; answers are matched by (chat, message[, filter]) from the purpose, never by a RequestId
trigger: open the Seen/Reacted dialog on a message, close it, reopen on the same message, switch reaction tabs while a page is out
effect: an answer of an older ask for the same message settles the newer ask; fail_audience(purpose) fails whichever ask is current
fix: Audience::Loading { request: RequestId } / Paging { request }

title: SetChangeStage::Working(SetChange) holds the kind of change but no RequestId; finish_set_change settles by set_id + change kind
trigger: Add then Archive of the same set in the sticker set box while the first request is out
effect: the first answer, if it names the same kind, ends the stage for the second request; guarded today only by the box disabling its buttons
fix: SetChangeStage::Working { change, request: RequestId }

title: ReplyTarget::Loading holds its RequestId but accept_replied_message / reject_replied_message settle by (chat, message) from the purpose, never comparing it
trigger: getRepliedMessage fails with a passing error, Retry elapses, the row is asked again (new request), then the first request's late answer or error lands
effect: the older request's answer or error overwrites the newer Loading stage (a late error bumps attempts and can flip to Missing while the newer ask is still out)
fix: apply/error arms compare ReplyTarget::Loading{request} with pending.id before writing

title: PendingRequest carries a bag of optional correlation fields (scope, forum_topic_id, user_id, supergroup_id, community_id, story_id, story_ids, story_album_id, user_ids, around_message_id, window_epoch) whose meaning depends on the purpose and is kept in step by the request_for_* helpers
trigger: any answer whose handler reads a field its builder did not set (for example around_message_id read as GetHistory's from_message_id and as GetGameHighScores' message)
effect: a handler that forgets the purpose check reads None or another request's meaning; the apply arms silently skip
fix: the correlation data lives inside RequestPurpose variants (purpose-specific payload) instead of side Options

title: ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then } names the target but holds no RequestId; finish_history_around matches the answer by message id (jump_serial is a second hand-bumped counter beside the stage)
trigger: jump to a message, jump to another, jump back to the first while the first around-page is still out
effect: the first request's answer (same message id) settles the second jump, or lands as stale; no way to tell the asks apart
fix: ChatSearchJump::Loading { request: RequestId, message_id, then }

title: take_sponsored_views marks ads viewed before viewMessages goes out; only a failed send untakes them, a TDLib error answer or a swept request leaves them marked
trigger: an ad shows while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers the viewMessages with an error (flood wait, 500) or the request is swept stale
effect: the ad stays in ChatSponsoredMessages::viewed, never sent again until the list is refetched after five minutes and dropped; the impression is not counted
fix: viewed ids held in a stage keyed by the ViewSponsoredMessages RequestId, released on error and lost-request settlement (no arm for RequestPurpose::ViewSponsoredMessages exists in the error or lost-request paths)

title: Translation::Pending holds a hand-made job number (TranslateState::next_job) instead of the RequestId; fail_orphaned_translations finds orphans by has_purpose(TranslateJob{job})
trigger: translate a chat's messages while requests are swept or dropped
effect: two numbering schemes (job and request) must stay in step; an orphan is detected by scanning the registry by purpose each pass
fix: Translation::Pending { request: RequestId, attempts } settled and cancelled by the request

title: one-shot answer slots write_access and phone_share are Option fields overwritten by the next answer; the first answer is lost if its taker has not drained it
trigger: two mini apps (two windows, or one app asking twice) ask canSendMessages / sharePhone and both answers land before the UI poll drains the slot
effect: the first mini app never gets its WriteAnswer or PhoneShare and waits on its request forever (the other one-shot queues are Vecs and keep both)
fix: a Vec<WriteAnswer> / map keyed by RequestId taken by the asker, like emoji_access and data_sent

title: SharedMediaTabStatus::Loading and NextPage::Loading hold no RequestId; the tab's request is told apart by SharedMediaTabState::generation and SharedMediaState::generation, a second counter beside the stage that the first-page, older-page and search paths restamp by hand
trigger: open the gallery, search in Files, switch tab, calendar-jump, scroll to older pages
effect: answers are trusted when a counter matches; the first-page and the older-page request of a tab share one stamp, so a duplicate older page for the same stamp is not distinguishable
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } and NextPage::Loading { request } compared on answer

title: GraphFetch::Loading is a bare in-flight stage; its request lives in a second map StatsState::graph_requests that must be kept in step by graph_requested / accept_graph / fail_graph
trigger: open statistics, zoom a graph, then leave the panel or hit a swept request
effect: a graph can read Loading with no entry in graph_requests (answer dropped silently), or an entry whose graph key was replaced
fix: GraphFetch::Loading { request: RequestId } and no side map

title: MessageStatsFetch defaults to Loading(None) (an Option used as the 'not sent yet' flag); fetch_message_statistics returns early on has_purpose(GetMessageStatistics) without recording the in-flight request id, so the in-flight answer matches nothing
trigger: open statistics of channel post A (request out), open post B (begin_message replaces the state), return to A before A's answer lands
effect: A's state is a fresh Loading(None); the early return leaves it so; A's answer fails waits_for(Some(id)) and is dropped; the page spins until the panel is reopened (the next call then sends a fresh request)
fix: adopt the registry's in-flight request id into Loading { request } instead of deduping by purpose, or hold MessageStatsFetch::Idle until a request id exists

title: PageFetch::Loading(None), StoryStatsFetch::Loading(None) and MessageStatsFetch::Loading(None) use an Option<RequestId> as the 'asked but not sent' flag; the stage is Loading with no request until a second call fills it
trigger: begin_story_search / story_search_page_requested / begin_story_insights then the send is skipped (locked, chats path inactive)
effect: a Loading with no request has no way out except a send call that may never come; an answer cannot be matched until the Some is written
fix: Idle until the request id exists; Loading { request: RequestId } written together with the registry entry

title: ThreadStatus::Resolving holds no RequestId; getMessageThread's answer is matched by origin chat and origin message id, and SwitchingChat/Starting/ReloadNeeded are driver-polled hand-off stages with no owner of the next step
trigger: open the same comment thread twice, or open it, close it, reopen it before the first answer
effect: an earlier getMessageThread answer for the same origin message resolves the newer view (apply_message_thread_info compares ids, not requests); the three hand-off stages rely on the UI poll to advance and have no timeout
fix: Resolving { request: RequestId } compared in apply_message_thread_info and fail_thread

title: deep-link stages are matched by a hand-bumped generation counter, not the RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Click two deep links in a row; the first link's late answer arrives after the second started
effect: No bug traced today: stale answers are dropped by comparing ChatsPurpose::DeepLink*{generation} to DeepLinkState::*::generation, a u64 from ChatsState::next_deep_link_generation, instead of the stage holding its RequestId (fetch.waits_for). Same 'counter to tell old answers from current' shape the state-machines doc names; every stage variant and every error arm must remember to compare it.
fix: DeepLinkState::Resolving{request: RequestId} variants compared with the answer's RequestId; delete deep_link_seq

title: baseline: GiveawaySummary::finished is a start/results variant held as a bool
trigger: none today
effect: `finished` is set true by parse_results and false by parse_start (the two constructors); nothing outside the envelope tests reads it, so it is a dead stage flag. The 'results' card also carries `info_message_id`/`unclaimed_count`/`was_refunded` that mean nothing for a start card.
fix: enum GiveawaySummary{Started{..}, Results{info_message_id, unclaimed, refunded, ..}}; delete `finished`

title: baseline: ParsedSession::is_password_pending bool
trigger: none (TDLib session.is_password_pending mirrored as is; the session list splits rows by it)
effect: none today
fix: allow-list as a server fact or fold into a SessionKind enum with is_current/is_unconfirmed

title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a box-open bit kept in the session beside the export's own stage
trigger: Start an account export, Hide it, switch account and back, reopen Settings > Data & Storage
effect: No bug today (view is closed by the dialog .close hook and read by the DialogSpec predicate); the box's open state is two places (ExportBox::Options in dialogs and export.view in the session) kept in step by hand
fix: fold the visibility into one ExportBox/ExportStage enum owned per account (OnScreen) instead of a Shown/Hidden bit on the session's export

title: BLOCKED queue keeps an entry for a chat window that closed before its next frame, and a later window for the same chat takes it
trigger: An agent's step opens a hard dialog in a chat window (Blocked{host: Some(chat)} is queued); the user closes that window before its next frame; later the user opens a window for the same chat and opens that same hard dialog by hand
effect: take_blocked_closing_layers partitions by host and screen only, so the stale entry is returned to the new window's shell, which closes the box the user opened (e.g. LogOut); the entry otherwise sits in the thread-local until the screen epoch changes
fix: drop entries whose host window is gone when a window closes (or key them by the window's slot/epoch, not the chat id), or make the queue part of the window's own state so it ends with the window

title: Detached forever-loop minute timer re-applies appearance (and the OS accent) while the window is hidden, locked or logged out; not in the owned-timers baseline
trigger: Launch Quill, lock it or log out, leave it for an hour
effect: 60 wakes an hour of apply_appearance (and refresh_system_accent with the system-accent option) behind the lock/in the background; cheap (apply_appearance only notifies on a change) but it is the `poll` + `detached` shape the guard exists for, and check-owned-timers.py skips this file because its name says demo, so it was never listed
fix: drive auto-night from a wake: observe the OS appearance/accent change and arm one timer for the next schedule boundary held in the appearance state, or poll in a task owned by the account/screen and parked while locked; rename or exclude only the demo parts of app_demo.rs from the guard

title: A custom theme file that failed to read is cached as `None` and not read again until the themes folder changes
trigger: Pick a custom theme as the day theme; at the next launch its file is unreadable for a moment (locked, mid-write by another tool); the read answers `None`
effect: resolve_app_theme falls back to the built-in default for the whole session and custom_cache keeps `(name, None)`; nothing sends the read again (only refresh_custom_themes, after a change made inside Quill, clears the cache)
fix: cache `Fetch<Palette>`-like stage (Ready/Failed) and treat Failed as a miss the next time the appearance is applied, or do not cache a failed read

title: AudioEngine keeps its stage in five fields changed together by hand: track, building, backend, standing, fault
trigger: Start a voice note, seek while it builds, fail the build, then resume (start/land/fail_build/resume/stop each reassign a different subset)
effect: No bug found: the transitions are covered by tests and `state()` derives the stage; but `Standing::Failed` and `Fault::{Seen,Unseen}` both say the last start failed, and `track`/`building`/`backend` decide Idle/Loading/Playing/Ended, so a new transition must update all five consistently (e.g. fail_build sets standing and fault, stop resets four of them but `simulation` is left)
fix: one `Playback` enum: Idle, Building{target,landing,old: Option<Track>,build}, Playing(Track), Held(Track,Fresh|Stale), Ended(Track), Failed{error,told} with the SimRun inside the Simulated variants

title: A background preparation ending never settles close waiters, so a deletion waiting on it sits until the 60 s cap and is Deferred
trigger: Remove an account while its background client is still being prepared (keychain read on a worker) and no other background client runs; the poll loop ends once the cancelled prepare no longer counts as work, then the worker finishes
effect: deletion_wait stays Wait; nothing calls settle_close_waiters when the worker ends (mod.rs:390 only calls prepare.finished); after CLOSE_GIVE_UP the waiter runs with go=false, so the folder stays recorded and is deleted only on the next start, and the key stays in deleting for the run
fix: call settle_close_waiters after prepare.finished (both early-return paths), or make has_work count running preparations

title: EditStage::Loading is a bare mirror of the session's edit-texts fetch, flipped to Editing by hand from frame upkeep
trigger: Open the bot edit box; fill_bot_edit (render upkeep) copies the texts and sets Editing once both are Ready
effect: no bug today; the real stage (session bots.owned.edit name/about Fetch, load_failed) sits beside the dialog's own Loading/Editing and the two are kept in step in fill_bot_edit only
fix: derive loaded from the session fetch, or hold the request id in Loading and settle it in the answer path

title: A looping ringtone is left with its output hold when the screen loses its session
trigger: A call rings on the account on screen (Voice::Looping), then the account logs out or its client closes so session() is None before the next sync
effect: sync_call_sounds returns at the `session()` check and the call tick ends (call_tick_wanted is false), so nobody calls keep_looping(None): the Looping stage and its output Hold stay (audio device held open) until a later sync with a session; the current ring finishes but no new one starts
fix: stop the voice in the screen's Farewell (or when session() is None) instead of relying on the next sync

title: A press that needs a device prompt is dropped without a note while another recording is starting
trigger: Press Call (or answer) with microphone access Undetermined while recording.starting() is true
effect: with_device_access returns at `if self.recording.starting()` and drops `start`; nothing happens and no status note says why, so the call press is silently lost
fix: say why (a note) or queue the start in the recording stage

title: EditMode::replace_as_file (bool) must change in step with the staged replacement it belongs to (ComposerEdit::media_edit.replacement)
trigger: Pick a replacement file while editing a media message, tick 'Send as document'; the replacement is cleared by clear_edit_replacement or a failed probe, and each of those sites resets replace_as_file by hand beside clearing the replacement
effect: No bug today; a new site that drops the replacement but forgets set_edit_replace_as_file(false) leaves the box ticked for the next file
fix: Make the as-file choice a field of the staged replacement value (Replacement { file, as_file }) so dropping the replacement drops the choice

title: checklist / add-tasks / poll-option dialogs close as soon as the request is sent; a server refusal loses the typed content
trigger: Compose a checklist (or Add Tasks, or a poll Add Option), press Create; the driver call returns Ok(request) so the dialog is set to None at once; TDLib then rejects the send (e.g. restricted chat, slow mode, deleted message)
effect: The dialog and everything typed in it are gone; only a generic status note remains, there is no way to retry without retyping
fix: Keep the dialog in a Sending { request: RequestId } stage and close it only on the matching answer; return it to Editing on error

title: CreateVisibility's busy state is read by purpose and chat (has_purpose_for_chat) rather than by the RequestId the box sent; check-request-match.py misses the _for_chat variant
trigger: Press Create on the create-community visibility box while another request of purpose CreateCommunity for the same chat is out (a second window, or the same send from an earlier box)
effect: The Create button shows loading / is disabled for a request this box did not send, and an answer for an earlier request ends the wrong wait
fix: Hold the create's RequestId in the box (CreateVisibility { sent: Option<RequestId> }, or a Creating { request } stage) and read busy from it; extend PURPOSE in scripts/check-request-match.py to has_purpose_for_chat

title: A waiting community ban (CommunitiesUi::ban_waits) can only leave on its member-chats answer; while another box stays open it waits with no cancel or expiry
trigger: Press Ban on a member who owns chats in the community, then open another box (Settings, a profile) and leave it open; the answer arrives and BanStep::Warn keeps returning false while any other dialog is up
effect: Closing that other box later pops the ban warning for a press the user has forgotten, and a ban queued behind it waits too; it needs a confirm, so nothing is banned unseen
fix: Make the wait one stage value with an owner and a cancel (BanWait::Asking { request } -> Warning), dropped when the box it was pressed from goes away

title: take_draft_clear falls back to any pending clear of the same chat (HashMap order) when the acked topic has none, instead of matching the request
trigger: Two topics of one forum chat each have a send waiting for its ack to clear the draft, or one has one and an unrelated send (a menu command that sets no clear) of another topic is acked first
effect: The ack takes some other topic's pending DraftClear, so that topic's draft can be cleared on the wrong ack, or the right ack finds nothing; which one is arbitrary (HashMap iteration order)
fix: Key the pending clear by the send's RequestId (DraftClear { request, .. }) and take it by the answered request, with no chat-id fallback

title: PlaybackState::pending_media_seek is an Option tuple with a bare ChatId and no account owner
trigger: Open a t.me/c/..?t=30 link, then switch account before the message loads, to an account that also shows the same chat id
effect: the seek can fire (or be dropped) for the other account's same-id chat; self-expires after 12 s
fix: hold it in the owning OnScreen/ChatUi as an enum MediaSeek::Waiting{chat: AccountChat, message, seconds, deadline}

title: links.deep_link_dialog is one Option<String> slot for a box that opens per window
trigger: Two typed links resolve to info text for two different windows before either box is closed
effect: the second text overwrites the first, so the first window's DeepLinkInfo box shows the second link's text; closing either clears the slot for both
fix: hold the text in the box stage owned by the window (WindowSlot) that opened it

title: FolderLoad::Merging is a bare in-flight stage; its answer is matched by purpose+folder id and the fetch is re-sent from upkeep
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere, press Save: start_folder_editor_merge sends fetch_chat_folder, drops the RequestId and enters Merging; settle_folder_editor_merge (run from maybe_prefill_folder_editor on every poll) matches with requests.has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, id) and re-sends fetch_chat_folder when no request and no error is left
effect: another window's/older GetChatFolder for the same folder counts as ours; a swept request is re-sent each poll; with no live session Merging has no way out except cancel
fix: Merging { request: RequestId } settled with fetch.waits_for/answered like Loading and Saving

title: DiskUi::screen_refused and start_refused are refusal-stage bools kept beside DiskStage and reset by hand
trigger: Disk falls below the open floor while Quill starts a client: connect_ui::refuse_screen_open sets screen_refused, background_accounts sets start_refused; apply_reading/reconnect_after_disk clear them from several places
effect: no bug today; the two flags must change together with DiskStage and are cleared from apply_reading, reconnect_after_disk and the DiskStep arms (not by DiskStage transitions)
fix: fold into DiskStage as a Refused{screen,starts} part of the single stage value

title: EarnUi::layer (EarnLayer::Open{back,restore}) mirrors Session users_state.open_info_panel == Earn(..) and must change with it
trigger: The Earn panel is closed by a path that sets open_info_panel directly (info-panel nav, account switch Farewell only drops it when earn_layer_open())
effect: no bug found: enter_earn_layer replaces a stale Open with a fresh one; but two owners (UI layer value and session open_info_panel) hold one fact
fix: derive Open from the session value and keep only back/restore/fade in a single EarnLayer owned by that value

title: Closing the Add folder box while Adding drops the stage and the add's outcome is never shown
trigger: Open an addlist link, tick chats, press Add, then close the box (X/Esc) before TDLib answers
effect: close_folder_invite only cancels a Checking request; the Adding request stays in the session, its answer sits unclaimed in dialog_answers (ring of 16) and no toast says whether the folder was added or the add failed

title: Closing the Share folder box during a link save/delete loses the answer and any error
trigger: Share folder box, press Save/Create/Delete link (LinkOp::Saving), close the box before the answer
effect: settle_folder_share only runs while the box is open, so a failure (error line) or limit hit is never shown anywhere; the link list silently stays as it was

title: FolderLoad::Merging holds no RequestId and its answer is matched by purpose+folder id
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere so the cached spec is stale, press Save: Merging is entered and upkeep polls has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, folder_id) and folder_specs.error(folder_id) every frame instead of waiting on the request that Merging sent
effect: No visible bug today (fetch_chat_folder dedups per folder and clears the error on send), but a GetChatFolder sent by another box (Share folder) for the same folder is taken as the merge's own answer, and the merge cannot tell its request from another
fix: FolderLoad::Merging { request: RequestId } set from fetch_chat_folder's Ok(Some(id)) (or the pending extra), settled by waits_for(id)

title: A second topic action overwrites the Waiting stage of the first
trigger: Choose Mark mentions read on a topic, then before TDLib answers choose Unpin all messages on another
effect: ChatUi::topic_action holds one Waiting{request,done}; the second action replaces it, so the first one's success toast never shows and its answer stays in topic_action_answers

title: baseline: DestRow::saved
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt (and allowed in implicit-state-allow.txt as a fact about the chat: Saved Messages), built once per frame in chooser_rows
effect: No bug; a fact read from the session when the rows are built, never stored across frames
fix: drop it from the baseline (the allow line already says it is not a stage)

title: FieldStage::Away/Typing is a 'focus taken' flag derived from ShowingView each frame
trigger: PasswordField::keep maps ShowingView to Away/Typing only to focus the field once per idle phase
effect: No bug; two-variant enum beside the caller's real stage (PasswordView/ShowingView)
fix: fold the focus latch into the caller's stage (Idle { focused }) or drop it for a Mount-style one-shot

title: GifTab::Asked holds no request: 'asked' is a flag beside the session's GifPanel loading state
trigger: A window sets GifTab::Asked(wanted) when it sends show_saved_gifs/search_gifs; the answer is read from the shared GifPanel by comparing GifWanted::shown(panel) to the wanted section, not by a RequestId held in the tab
effect: No bug traced today; another window's search or a failed answer is inferred from the shared list, and Wants/Asked only stop upkeep from asking again
fix: GifTab::Asked { wanted, request: RequestId } settled by the answer to that request

title: The craft's forge is two stage values kept in step by hand: CraftStage::Forging (UI) and CraftRun::Crafting (session)
trigger: craft_now starts the forge on the UI side when the driver accepts craftGift; craft_frame_upkeep ends it only when both the 3 s timer and craft.crafting() allow, and after_craft_pop reads both to decide whether the craft may go
effect: No bug traced; each side must be cleared with the other (a lost answer would leave Forging with crafting() true and the ring spinning)
fix: one stage value: Forging { since, request } whose answer ends it, with the session holding only the result

title: FileAskOutcome::Sent is an 'asked once' flag: the download's answer is never matched
trigger: gift_market_frame_upkeep calls download_file for each sticker file shown by the open box and records Sent; a download that later fails leaves Sent in requested_files, so nothing asks again while the boxes stay open
effect: A sticker of the gift market that failed to download shows its placeholder until every market box is closed (drop_orphans clears requested_files)
fix: FileAsk::Sent { request: RequestId } cleared by the file's answer, or ask through the session's own file state

title: A refused volume send leaves the slider on the dragged value
trigger: Release the stage volume slider while set_group_call_participant_volume returns None (send refused)
effect: stage is set to Made(made), which equals the server level, so serves() keeps the dragged slider and it shows a volume the server never got (the Sent stage snaps back, this path does not)
fix: on a refused send leave the stage so the slider is made again from the server level

title: GroupCallScreen::window_closed_by_user is an Option<call id> dismissal flag cleared by hand from many sites
trigger: Set in close_group_call_window, on_window_should_close, the stream-ended sync and a failed window open; cleared in show_group_call_window and note_stream_join_intent; sync_group_call_window reads it to decide whether the call window exists
effect: No bug traced (call ids do not repeat in a client and the screen owns the value), but the 'window wanted' decision is spread over a CallWindow stage, this Option and StreamWatch
fix: a CallWindow::Dismissed { call } variant set and cleared only by CallWindow transitions

title: baseline: StreamFacts::transport_failed
trigger: StreamFacts is rebuilt every draw from call.transport.error().is_some(); settle_stream_join reads it to end a join that failed without a join error
effect: No bug; the real stage is the call's transport value, this bool is a per-draw snapshot of it
fix: carry the transport stage (or Option<&str> error) in StreamFacts instead of a bool

title: sticker-pack busy is matched by purpose+chat, not the RequestId of the change
trigger: Pick a pack in two windows of the same chat, or an older request for the chat is in flight
effect: Buttons disabled by another request's presence; the click handler itself never checks busy so a fast double click sends twice
fix: Keep the sent RequestId in the pack-choice stage and compare it

title: Edit box stage is reset by hand at three call sites instead of its own close path
trigger: Save with nothing changed, Save in demo mode, or Save whose send list is empty: the box is dropped with admin.group_edit_box = None
effect: close_group_edit_box also clears the emoji panel and earn.ask_boost; these three exits skip the second (and rely on the first being called at the top of save)
fix: Route every exit through close_group_edit_box (or make the box own its sub-state so replacing it whole is enough)

title: global probe cache keeps a bare Probing stage with a detached notify task; no owner and no way out if the probe job hangs
trigger: Open a chat with an HDR picture on a stalled network drive; the probe job never returns
effect: The file's HDR badge/viewer stays off for the rest of the process (Probing is never retried)
fix: Entry::Probing { job: Task<Option<bool>> } held per window slot, or Fetch<bool> keyed by path

title: InlineBotNotice {Unconfirmed, Confirmed} is a bool kept as a two-variant enum
trigger: User confirms the inline-bot notice in a session
effect: Not persisted beyond the account's OnScreen; shape is just confirmed: bool
fix: A persisted setting (settings store) or drop the notice state if the confirmation is a per-session fact

title: MembersStage::Loading carries a RequestId that nothing reads (dead_code expected)
trigger: Open a group info panel while its member list loads
effect: Stage names a request but the answer is matched by (chat, filter) in the session, not by this id
fix: Drop the unused request field or settle the list by it (Fetch<T> keyed by RequestId)

title: A clip whose sync open fails is opened again on every render
trigger: A visible muted GIF/video tile whose VideoPlayer::open returns Err (file unreadable or unsupported)
effect: frame() runs open() each frame because the slot never exists; wasted decoder setup per render, still shows the still picture
fix: Insert a Stuck slot (Presence::Stuck) when open fails so the tile is retried only when its source changes

title: apply_custom_bindings returns silently when the keymap is borrowed, but the caller still records Keymap::Applied(account)
trigger: An account's keybindings are applied (notifications/mod.rs apply_pending_keybindings) while the GPUI keymap RefCell is borrowed; try_borrow fails and the function returns without installing anything
effect: Keymap says it carries the account's overrides, so apply_pending_keybindings never retries; the account's custom chords (or the previous account's chords remain) until the next rebind or account change
fix: apply_custom_bindings returns bool/Result; caller sets Keymap::Applied only on success

title: A recent language pack deleted then re-picked stays in LanguageBox::removed; a later Restore inserts a duplicate into recent
trigger: Settings > Language: delete recent pack X (removed=[X], dimmed row stays clickable), pick X (install_language -> with_recent puts X back in recent; removed still holds X), pick another pack Y so X is no longer checked, open X's menu: it offers Restore (removed.iter().any) and remove_recent_language(restore=true) inserts X again at recent[index] with no duplicate check
effect: Two rows for the same pack with the same element id, and a duplicate saved in language_recent.json
fix: install_language drops a re-picked pack from LanguageBox::removed (or remove/restore keyed as one list of RecentEntry{choice, Kept|Removed(index)})

title: Dropping a Linux/Windows Locating lookup cancels nothing: cancel() is a no-op and the thread keeps its GeoClue client for up to 20 s
trigger: Open Send Location, then close the picker (or switch account) while 'locating'
effect: The GeoClue client (location indicator in the desktop shell) stays started until the fix or the 20 s timeout; its answer is sent to a dropped Receiver
fix: hold a cancel token (AtomicBool/oneshot) in Locating that the lookup selects on alongside the timer

title: chat_preview_overlay draws its loading skeleton from requests.has_purpose_for_chat(GetChatPreview, chat) instead of the chat_preview_fetch Fetch it already reads
trigger: Peek preview of a chat while another window/older request for the same chat is in flight
effect: busy state is read by purpose+chat id, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch (same shape the request-match guard rejects for has_purpose); no wrong output seen because one request per chat
fix: fetch.is_loading() (Fetch::Loading{request}) for the skeleton

title: send_message_report_text clears the report details field even when report_messages could not be sent
trigger: Report > a reason that needs details > type text > Report while the send is refused (driver Err): the note says 'Could not send the report' and the flow stays on TextRequired
effect: The typed details are gone and must be retyped
fix: clear the field only when the send was accepted (or when the flow leaves TextRequired)

title: The Instant View reader (Session::messages.instant_view) has no closer in MessageUi's Farewell, so it comes back after switching accounts and back
trigger: Open an Instant View link in account A (the full-window reader overlay shows), switch to account B (replace_screen), switch back to A
effect: A's reader overlay (opaque, inset_0, occludes the chat) is drawn again over the restored screen until the user presses Esc or its close button; sibling session-held boxes (message_report, replies_block) are closed by this very Farewell for the same reason
fix: close it in MessageUi::farewell (session.messages.instant_view = None) or hold the reader in an OnScreen-owned enum

title: ParagraphText keeps click_ranges, actions and link_flags as three parallel Vecs that every push site must extend together
trigger: Any new run kind in paragraph_text (a sixth push site) that pushes a range and an action but forgets link_flags (or the reverse)
effect: None today: all seven push sites extend the three together; the consumer zips them by index, so a miss would shift every later click target and hover underline
fix: one Vec<ClickTarget { range, action, is_link }>

title: scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a full object built from the session snapshot, so two quick toggles lose the first
trigger: Open Notifications defaults; toggle 'Show message preview' then, before TDLib's updateScopeNotificationSettings arrives, toggle 'Notify about mentions' for the same scope (same for apply_reaction_*)
effect: The second send carries the old preview value, so the server ends with the first change reverted and the switch snaps back
fix: Keep a per-scope Edit stage (draft + request id) in the settings ui and merge the next field into the in-flight draft, or send field-level patches

title: avatar decode 'in flight' is a thread_local map entry (empty Vec) with no Task, cleared only by a detached task
trigger: A first notification for an avatar starts the decode; if the app task never reaches the remove (spawn_app task dropped, app update failing before the remove)
effect: No bug today; later notifications for that photo path queue behind a decode nobody will finish and never show
fix: Hold the decode as a stage (Decoding { job: Task }) in NotifyDelivery keyed by path, so dropping it ends the wait

title: Shown::sending holds one Sending per (account, chat), so two Notify calls in flight for the same chat share one withdrawal mark
trigger: Two messages for one chat arrive together (two workers call show); the chat is read (close) while both Notify calls are on the bus
effect: The first land consumes the Withdrawn mark and closes only its own id; the second toast lands with no mark and stays up although the chat was read
fix: key sending by a per-call ticket (call id) and withdraw all tickets of the chat

title: the capability probe thread loops forever at REPROBE while the daemon is Missing, whether the app is locked, hidden or notifications are off
trigger: Run without a notification daemon: quill-notify-caps connects to the session bus every 30 s for the life of the process
effect: Wasted work only (a thread with a bare sleep, outside the owned-timers guard, which counts async timers)
fix: probe on demand (when the Notifications page or a first notification asks) behind a quill::wake signal, not on a clock

title: poll loop is a detached task named by connect.generation instead of a task held by the client
trigger: restart_live_connection / client replaced: the old loop ends only when it next wakes and compares generation
effect: No bug today; baseline:detached QuillApp::spawn_poll_loop
fix: hold the poll Task in the LiveConnect stage so replacing the client cancels it

title: Pay on a composer paid-send confirmation resubmits the text, which opens the same confirmation again unless 'Don't ask me again' is ticked
trigger: Live account; open a chat whose other side charges Stars; type text and Send; the Confirm payment box opens; leave 'Don't ask me again' unticked and press Pay
effect: confirm_paid_send replaces the stage with None and calls submit_composer, whose live branch (composer/mod.rs:174) calls paid_send_waits again; needs_confirmation is still true (the price is not trusted), so a new Composer stage is made and the box reopens. The message never goes out unless the user ticks the trust box (which stores a price they did not want to remember). The unit tests run on the demo session where `plan` is None and the check is skipped
fix: Make Pay hand the submit an 'agreed for this send' value (a field of the Composer stage carried into the one resubmit) that paid_send_waits honours once, or send through the PaidGuard release path instead of resubmitting

title: CardInput::invalid and CardForm::country_invalid are error flags set by Done and cleared by the next edit of the same field, beside the text they judge
trigger: Press Done with a bad number (show_card_error sets invalid); edit another field
effect: No bug today; the mark is about the text at that moment but is a bool not tied to it (TitleCheck in new_chat holds the judged text instead)
fix: FieldCheck { Fine, Rejected(judged text) } compared with the current text

title: Backspace/Delete snapshot is cleared by two nested defers matched by a press counter
trigger: Press Backspace in a card field; DeleteEdit::Pending{press} is cleared by a defer-of-a-defer comparing `press`
effect: No bug today; the counter tells an old defer from the current press (the shape the timers guard names)
fix: take the snapshot in the Change handler of the same effect cycle (one place), or hold it in a stage that the Change consumes and the next frame drops

title: Share's card PNG is written to a temp file on a worker thread; closing the box mid-render drops the task so nothing removes the file
trigger: Open a QR box, press Share, close the box before the render ends (the Export::Rendering task is dropped with the box)
effect: clipboard_image_attachment already wrote the card file; `done` never runs, so remove_card_file is never called and the card PNG stays in the temp dir
fix: have the worker return the path through a drop guard (a TempCard owner) that deletes the file when the result is dropped unclaimed

title: the cropped profile photo is written to a temp PNG before its target is checked; a closed target leaves the file behind
trigger: Set Photo on the crop, then close the Edit box (or the target's dialog) before the render ends
effect: finish_profile_crop's callback returns at `photo_target() != Some(target)` after write_edited_png ran, so the PNG is never removed; the same on a take_chosen_photo error
fix: remove `saved` on the early returns (as render_attachment_edit does for a stale render)

title: edit renders are numbered (NEXT_RENDER, EditRender::Rendering(n), extras.begin_render(n)) and their tasks are detached, so the stage names a render it does not own
trigger: Press Done twice on the same photo, or Done then remove the card: the older render finishes and is told apart from the newest only by its number
effect: No bug today (each landing removes its own file when it is stale); the number stands in for holding the Task
fix: EditRender::Rendering { _job: Task<()> } held in the tray item so replacing it cancels the older render

title: public links list sends load_created_public_chats from render while fetch is None
trigger: Open the public-links limit box while the send fails (driver offline / queue closed) so PublicChatsFetch stays None
effect: The request is re-sent each time the box re-renders; no Failed stage is entered so no retry button shows, only 'Loading' forever
fix: send once when the box opens and move the fetch to Failed on a send error (Fetch<T>)

title: StarPacksState::open mirrors hub.stars.open and is folded by hand in close_stars
trigger: Open Stars, expand Buy more Stars, close the box by any path that does not run close_stars (account switch, Farewell)
effect: None today (close_stars resets it); a second owner of 'Stars box shown' that must be kept in step by hand, also set by hand in story_viewer/live_story.rs
fix: fold the packs section into the Stars stage enum (Stars::Open{packs: Folded|Expanded}) so closing the box replaces both

title: mutate_privacy_detail claims to ignore Loading/Failed but edits the stale rule
trigger: Open Settings > Privacy (fetch_privacy puts every key in Loading{stale}), change the rule on another device, open the editor and tap an exception before the refetch answers; or refetch Failed while offline
effect: detail() returns Loading/Failed `stale`, so the edit is composed on the old rule and saved, overwriting the other device's newer exceptions; the comment above says Loading/Failed edits are ignored
fix: edit only from Ready/Saving/SaveFailed (a method `editable_detail()` that returns None for Loading/Failed)

title: Gift settings are written optimistically and never rolled back when setGiftSettings fails
trigger: Premium account, Privacy > Gifts, flip a gift-type switch while offline or when TDLib refuses (driver.set_gift_settings calls set_my_gift_settings_local, then the answer is an error)
effect: An error line shows under the block but the switch stays in the flipped position, so the UI shows a setting the server does not have until the full user info is refetched; two quick flips also build the second edit on the first unconfirmed value
fix: hold the saved/confirmed GiftSettings beside the in-flight one under its RequestId (like PrivacyKeyState::Saving) and restore the confirmed value on error

title: Password check clears the field and drops a refused send without any feedback
trigger: Privacy page password check card, type the password and press Check while the driver refuses the send (not connected / chats path inactive)
effect: The typed password is wiped, the card stays in Idle with no 'Checking' and no error note; the button looks like it did nothing
fix: on Err move PasswordCheck to Failed (as the dismiss path shows a note) so the card says it could not reach Telegram

title: Personal channel picker shows Loading forever when its fetch could not be sent
trigger: Edit profile > personal channel while fetch_suitable_personal_chats returns Err (driver offline / sender closed): open_personal_channel_dialog drops the result with `let _ =`
effect: No profile_chat_lists entry exists, so the box matches `None` and says Loading with no Retry row until it is closed and reopened
fix: treat a refused send as ProfileChatsFetch::Failed so the Retry row shows, as retry_profile_chats does

title: PullUi keeps the pull stage in two values: PullMachine (jumping/has_next) and Route (Found/Jumping)
trigger: Swipe to the next channel and release: begin_jump sets machine.jumping and Route::Jumping together; pull_find_next writes machine.set_has_next and Route::Found as separate statements; pull_jump_ended resets both by hand from three call sites
effect: None today (begin_jump/restart keep them in step); a new path that touches only one leaves the indicator full with no task, or a task with no indicator
fix: fold the route into the machine's stage (Pulling{next}, Jumping{next, task}) so has_next and the jump task cannot disagree

title: QuickRepliesDialog::watch is an Option<Rc<Task>> used as 'a poll is running' flag beside pane.stage
trigger: Add a quick reply text: submit_quick_reply_text sets PaneStage::Saving then quick_replies_watch starts a 200 ms poll loop only when watch is None; the loop clears watch itself and restarts if stage.sending()
effect: No bug today; the poll's life is split between the Option and PaneStage::{Saving,Accepted,Deleting}, and the end-of-poll code re-checks sending() to patch a save sent as the poll ended
fix: put the poll task inside the waiting PaneStage variants (Saving{request, _poll}, Accepted{_poll}) so leaving the stage ends the poll and no restart check is needed

title: Chooser::Listing is an in-flight stage with no task: a detached listing task and a generation counter tell old answers from the current one
trigger: Open the share-screen chooser: open_screen_chooser sets Chooser::Listing{generation} and spawns a task it then .detach()es; the answer and every thumbnail compare `generation` (screen_chooser_listed, load_thumbnails), and screen_chooser_closed bumps the counter to invalidate them
effect: None today; the stage names work whose handle lives nowhere, so cancelling is a counter bump and an old Listing from another screen epoch must be recognised by `epoch` as well
fix: hold the listing task in Chooser::Listing{ _list: Task<()> } and the thumbnail task in Open, drop the generation counters

title: self-destruct badge tick keeps waking every second while Quill is locked or the window hidden
